rules.rule: a characteristic of the required list (functional suitability, performance efficiency, reliability, security, maintainability and safety) that no target names
a target whose characteristic is none of the nine of ISO/IEC 25010 and none of the 4 aliases of the configuration, or is empty
a target with a sub-characteristic that is not one of src/model.js, or that belongs to another characteristic
a target with an empty measurement method, or a targets file with no method column
a target with an empty owner, or a targets file with no owner column
a target with no unit, or a target or measurement whose unit is none of the units of src/units.js and the 1 alias of the configuration, or that names two different units
a measurement whose unit measures another dimension than the unit of its target
a target whose metric and comparison an earlier target already has
a target whose metric has no measurement in the measurements files
a measurement that does not meet the comparison of its target
a measurement whose metric no target names
a target or measurement with no metric, the wrong number of fields, no target or value the tool can read, or a value of the wrong kind
a targets or measurements file that the tool could not read as UTF-8 text
a targets or measurements file that the CSV or JSON reader refuses, or whose header or shape is not that of its role
